title: Design System: Issue Agent Operator Console

title.purpose: Issue titles and prominent local headings.

body.purpose: Default operational prose and interface text.

label.purpose: Tracked uppercase panel, rail, and table labels.

machine.purpose: IDs, repositories, paths, time, money, tokens, models, and serialized evidence.

shadows.name: working-lift
shadows.purpose: Active work, tooltips, and medium overlays.

shadows.name: overlay-lift
shadows.purpose: Menus, modals, quota cards, and toasts.

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Compact operational action with a raised navy surface.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 30px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 15%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--elevated); color: var(--ink); font: 520 12px/1.45 var(--font-sans); transition: background var(--t), border-color var(--t), color var(--t); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--pressed); border-color: var(--border-emphasis); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:active { background: var(--pressed); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action that materializes on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 30px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: transparent; color: var(--ink-muted); font: 520 12px/1.45 var(--font-sans); transition: background var(--t), color var(--t); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--hover); color: var(--ink); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: var(--pressed); }

components.name: Filter Field
components.description: Compact filter field for dense tables.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">Filter issues <input class="ds-field" placeholder="Title, state, model…"></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: var(--ink-muted); font: 600 11px/1.2 var(--font-sans); } .ds-field { padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); outline: none; background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); font: 400 11px/1.45 var(--font-sans); } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--border-emphasis); } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--focus-ring); }

components.name: Semantic Chip
components.description: A compact label whose color is always tied to semantic state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 22px; padding: 1px 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--running) 32%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--running) 10%, transparent); color: var(--running); font: 620 11px/1.6 var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: .02em; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--running) 55%, transparent); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The default matte container, separated by tone and a hairline border.
components.html:
Active lifecycle
Operational evidence stays compact and attached.
components.css: .ds-panel { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); } .ds-panel-hd { min-height: 42px; padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--ink-muted); font: 620 11px/1.2 var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: .075em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-panel-bd { padding: 12px; color: var(--ink-muted); font: 400 13px/1.45 var(--font-sans); } .ds-panel:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); } .ds-panel:focus-within { border-color: var(--border-emphasis); }

components.name: Route Tab
components.description: Rectangular navigation tab with a periwinkle route edge.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; height: 55px; background: var(--surface-sidebar); } .ds-tab { position: relative; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-muted); font: 400 12px/1 var(--font-sans); } .ds-tab:hover { background: var(--hover); color: var(--ink); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-tab-active { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--ink); font-weight: 620; } .ds-tab-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0; height: 2px; background: var(--accent); } .ds-tab-count { padding: 0 5px; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--selection); color: var(--ink-muted); }

components.name: Lifecycle Topology
components.description: The signature route from completed through active and future issue stages.
components.html:
1. ✓Resolve
  2. •Review
  3. •CI
components.css: .ds-life { display: flex; width: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0 20px; list-style: none; color: var(--ink-faint); } .ds-stage { position: relative; display: flex; flex: 1; min-width: 54px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink-faint); font: 520 11px/1.2 var(--font-sans); } .ds-stage:not(:first-child)::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 17px; right: 50%; width: 100%; height: 1px; background: var(--border-emphasis); } .ds-node { z-index: 1; display: grid; width: 34px; height: 34px; place-items: center; border: 1.5px solid var(--border-emphasis); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface-sunken); color: var(--ink-muted); } .ds-complete, .ds-active { color: var(--accent); } .ds-complete::before, .ds-active::before { background: var(--accent) !important; } .ds-complete .ds-node { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent); color: var(--c-fg); } .ds-active .ds-node { border: 2px solid var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); } .ds-stage:hover .ds-node { border-color: currentColor; background: var(--elevated); } .ds-stage:focus-within .ds-node { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Error Banner
components.description: Local failure treatment that preserves surrounding data and offers recovery.
components.html: !Issue data could not refresh; showing last known data.
components.css: .ds-banner { display: flex; min-height: 40px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--fail) 34%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fail) 8%, var(--panel)); color: var(--ink); font: 400 12px/1.45 var(--font-sans); } .ds-banner-mark { display: grid; width: 24px; height: 24px; flex: none; place-items: center; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fail) 12%, transparent); color: var(--fail); font-weight: 700; } .ds-banner-action { margin-left: auto; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: transparent; color: var(--ink-muted); } .ds-banner-action:hover { background: var(--hover); color: var(--ink); } .ds-banner-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Issue Agent is a compact, dark operations surface whose visual model is a live execution graph rather than a collection of generic dashboard tiles. Matte graphite and navy layers create a calm working field; one restrained periwinkle route line carries navigation, selection, and lifecycle progress through it.

The interface is deliberately dense, crisp, and operational. Attention, daemon health, active work, ownership, and the next intervention lead; aggregate metrics and historical trends remain quieter and lower in the reading order. Detail is progressively disclosed without removing the surrounding execution context.
keyCharacteristics: Matte graphite/navy tonal layering with fine, low-contrast borders.
Periwinkle topology lines and active markers used as a route, not decoration.
Red, amber, green, violet, and cyan reserved for stable semantic roles.
Compact square controls and dense tables built for repeated scanning.
Monospace restricted to machine data; human language stays sans-serif.

rules.name: The One Route Rule
rules.body: Periwinkle connects navigation and lifecycle progress; it is not a general-purpose fill for large surfaces.

rules.name: The Semantic Redundancy Rule
rules.body: Never communicate operational state with color alone; pair it with a label, glyph, edge, or topology position.

rules.name: The Quiet History Rule
rules.body: Historical totals stay neutral at the container level; only the meaningful value receives semantic color.

rules.name: The Machine Data Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only when the content is generated, measured, addressed, or serialized by the system.

rules.name: The Compact Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Create hierarchy with weight, tone, tracking, and grouping before increasing type size.

rules.name: The Operational Order Rule
rules.body: Attention, live health, active lifecycle, and operator actions precede metrics, spend, and trends.

rules.name: The Evidence-in-Place Rule
rules.body: Expanded evidence stays attached to its row or lifecycle stage and remains readable inside horizontal scrollers.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Use surface steps and hairline borders for ordinary hierarchy; a shadow means the element floats, overlays, or demands attention.

rules.name: The Compact Control Rule
rules.body: Controls remain square-leaning and precise; do not turn buttons, inputs, or panels into pills.

dos: Do lead operational screens with required human action, live health, and active lifecycle state.
Do reuse the semantic tone vocabulary and provide a label, glyph, edge, or position alongside every color signal.
Do keep rows compact, numbers tabular, and long evidence progressively disclosed in place.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion alternatives.
Do use the 2–32px spacing scale and the 4/6/10/12px corner hierarchy.
donts: Don't replace topology and issue lanes with a generic grid of equal-weight metric cards.
Don't use periwinkle as broad decoration or let historical analytics compete with live work.
Don't apply monospace to prose, navigation labels, or headings simply to make the console feel technical.
Don't use pills for ordinary buttons, inputs, panels, or tabs.
Don't blank the whole screen for a local fetch error or hide the reason an area is empty.
